Resident state acquisition is an Effect with one Ref per acquisition; synchronous factory remains a host bridge for existing callers

Dispatch boundary check rejects independently acquired dispatch Ref ownership
Revision identity mappings and current native work handles moved from ResidentServer fields into the shared canonical/native Ref, with draft registration/reuse/supersession/release operations
Revision commits check native subject, input identity and generation agreement before publication; immutable revision tokens fence stale native handles after numeric generation reuse

Revision boundary check requires domain operations in their owner and rejects independent server revision fields or a separate revision Ref
Client request transport uses Effect.callback with acquireUseRelease socket ownership and one absolute verification/response deadline; interruption destroys the connected native socket

Client readiness, dispatch context, admission, shared and ticketed collection, acknowledgement/finalization and composed protocol workflows compose directly as named Effects; public Promise bridges preserve host call sites
Codex direct dispatch and status workflows consume client Effects directly, removing nested Promise runtimes at those Effect call sites
Client launch throttling uses monotonic expiry pruning without native expiry timers; fixture Promise ports remain pending controlled-service conversion
Claude bounded edit collection composes client Effects with timeout interruption and Schedule polling instead of Promise.race and native sleep timers
Composed prompt/edit/background/Stop hooks compose client Effects directly and use scoped acquisition finalizers for Stop attempts and background claims; the obsolete async workflow was deleted
Composed hooks consume explicit runtime and output services; CLI root supplies production layers and controlled tests supply clock/identity/client/output ports without native timers or IPC
HookOutput owns stdout error observers through acquireUseRelease on success, error, deadline and interruption; submitted bytes remain uncertain after deadline or cancellation
Stop output interruption preserves continuation conservatively; only a proven pre-write refusal closes the attempt and releases the submission

Direct CLI submission, output acknowledgement and original-owner finalization now compose in the root Effect workflow through DirectHookSubmission and HookOutput services; removed the Promise write workflow and imperative post-program submission path
The direct hook watchdog is a scoped Effect fiber bound to the original absolute host deadline; a timed-out write retains the watchdog until its process exit boundary

Direct submission finalizers release an original lease on interruption before output handoff and retain uncertainty once writing may have started; refused admission and reported write errors release once without recording or acknowledging
Encoded and composed JSON output share one callback/resource owner; the native Writable adapter keeps its error observer through the queued error event before removing it
Direct submission trace configuration is acquired through Config in its production layer; controlled submission services test write/record/acknowledgement ordering and original resident identity

Finding selection uses the bounded shared resident partition identity registry; deleted the server-local partition map/counter and collection-side identity allocation, with an explicit missing-ownership check

Native ticket-unit identities and immutable revision/advice metadata now share the canonical/capacity/reuse/delivery/dispatch/revision Ref; deleted the server unit Set, unit counter and mutable current-field assignments

Ticket unit admission and progress stage canonical transitions and native metadata in one commit; metadata validation failure rolls back both state owners and rejected admission consumes no native identity
Frozen ticket-unit capabilities fence forgotten handles and numeric identity reuse after shared-owner clearing; stage views avoid cloning the native unit map
Shutdown retains ticket-unit ownership through physical dispatch settlement and clears it with the canonical owner; no separate native unit clear path remains

Parent ticket records, immutable nonce/lifetime metadata and admission generation allocation now share the canonical/capacity/reuse/delivery/dispatch/revision/unit Ref; deleted the server ticket Map and admission counter

Ticket opening, retention eviction and partition retirement stage canonical admission state, native ticket records and unit binding retirement in one commit; validate native/canonical admission membership before publication
Unit admission requires its retained parent capability; stale parent records cannot attach work to a replacement using the same nonce or generation after clear
Removed the public metadata-only unit forget path; parent retirement and whole-owner clearing fence ticket and unit handles together
Ticket and retention boundary checks follow the new native metadata owner while preserving canonical event and retired-policy guards
Joined-review subscriber membership and immutable revision bindings now share the canonical/native Ref; deleted the server joined-review Map and mutable attachment path
Owner claim attachment, subscriber revision attachment and ticket-unit metadata stage in one commit; release and supersession stage subscriber retirement with unit progress
Joined subscribers retain only activity root/advicee metadata, rather than the full source-bearing observation; activity recording runs after publication
Whole-owner clearing retains subscriber state through physical dispatch settlement and clears all native domains together
Default resident lifetime generation now runs at state acquisition rather than Effect recipe construction; repeated acquisitions reject tickets from another owner lifetime
